title: Brückner Group
content:
Overview:
The Brückner Group is the market leader in the engineering of machines and systems for plastics and alternative materials. We are a family-owned company whose global success is built on technological market leadership. Our strong business units – Brückner Maschinenbau, Brückner Servtec, Hennecke, Kiefel and PackSys Global – are synonymous with specialized solutions and unique synergies in the fields of plastics & alternatives, packaging & technical applications, machines & production plants as well as solution providing. Marrying global presence and local commitment, we offer our customers excellent service, innovative technologies, and sustainable partnerships. Whether in Siegsdorf, Freilassing, Sankt Augustin, Rüti, Topolcany, Navi Mumbai, Dover, Bogota, Chon Buri, or Suzhou – the Brückner Group is at home around the world and is shaping the future of the plastics and packaging industry. title: Brückner Group SE - Extrusion-World
content: # Brückner Group SE. The Brückner Group has been family-owned since it was founded in 1960. This has characterised the Group to this day and is reflected in particular in its long-term strategic orientation - a key success factor for our customers and ourselves. Brückner Maschinenbau is the world's leading supplier of production systems for the manufacture of high-quality monoaxially and biaxially stretched films. It was founded in 1960. The systems guarantee customers efficient, profitable and reliable production of a wide variety of flexible films, which are used as high-quality packaging material or for special technical applications, such as capacitors, battery separators or screens and displays. Brückner Maschinenbau's range of services includes the planning, construction and commissioning of complete production plants and turnkey factories as well as all process and machine engineering developments for film production. The globally unique technology centre in Siegsdorf is increasingly working on important future topics such as e-mobility, intelligent packaging and sustainability in film production.

title: Brückner USA
content: Five Strong Business Units Form the Basis of Our Actions. ## Your Center for Service and Engineering Excellence. Brueckner Group USA, based in Dover, New Hampshire, is your trusted partner for sales, service, and production support across the United States, Canada, and Mexico. At the heart of our operations is the Customer Innovation Center, where we bring new ideas and technologies to life. As the independent distribution partner for all Brückner Group business units, we deliver custom solutions and top-tier service across North America – from testing and innovation to repair and maintenance – ensuring your operations stay efficient, reliable, and future-ready. We develop pioneering systems and technologies for the processing of polyurethane in the form of tailored and standardized customer solutions. In 2026, we will introduce a new leading company within the Brückner Group: Hennecke PUR Solutions will expand the Group’s portfolio with key technologies for processing polyurethane (PUR).
